Risk: Unauthorised customer accesses another customer's account/order/support data
Controls/mitigations: Server-side authentication and ownership checks; UUID identifiers; negative-path tests; no AI bypass

Risk: Administrator privilege escalation or excessive privileged access
Controls/mitigations: Separate admin identity; deny-by-default RBAC; least privilege; privileged-action audit

Risk: Excessive customer context disclosed to AI provider
Controls/mitigations: Purpose-specific context builder; bounded server-side tools; no unrestricted DB access; minimisation tests

Risk: AI output invents or exposes unsupported customer/business facts
Controls/mitigations: Palermo data remains authoritative; validate output; AI failure isolation; own-data tools enforce ownership

Risk: Raw payment credentials stored/logged by Palermo
Controls/mitigations: Stripe provider-controlled UI; only provider reference/status persisted; logging prohibition; test fixtures never use real PAN/CVV

Risk: Optional fragrance sensitivity is treated as medical/health data
Controls/mitigations: Explicit non-medical scope; optional field; UI wording and validation; no health inference

Risk: Free-text support/review content contains unexpected personal/sensitive information
Controls/mitigations: Purpose notice; minimise prompts/context; bounded retention; moderation/support access controls

Risk: Logs expose secrets, tokens or personal data
Controls/mitigations: Structured logging policy; prohibited-value checks; correlation IDs instead of secrets; restricted log access

Risk: Public reviews expose direct account identifiers
Controls/mitigations: Do not publish email/internal UUID; minimise public reviewer label; moderation controls

Risk: Backups preserve deleted data beyond active-store removal
Controls/mitigations: 30-day rolling backup retention; restricted restore; restore runbook reapplies retention/deletion controls

Risk: Customer interprets account deactivation as deletion
Controls/mitigations: Explicit UI/policy distinction; retention schedule; deactivation invalidates session but does not claim erasure

Risk: Visitor session identifiers become linkable personal profiles
Controls/mitigations: Opaque identifiers; bounded 30/90-day retention; no direct identity requirement for visitor flows
Aggregate preference/quiz reporting where identity unnecessary; RBAC on admin reporting

Risk: Provider region/contract/data-use terms are unsuitable for production
Controls/mitigations: Production provider review required before launch; capstone/demo uses seeded non-real data; adapters allow provider substitution

Risk: Development/test environment contains real customer information
Controls/mitigations: D-106/D-111 seeded non-real demo data; no production secrets in CI fixtures
